```yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09" Description: > Single t3.micro Amazon Linux 2023 web server in an existing default VPC. Apache serves a home page over HTTPS (self-signed certificate) to the internet. SSH (port 22) is allowed only from the administrator CIDR supplied at stack creation. No new VPC, subnet, gateway, or route table is created. Parameters: VpcId: Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id Description: The default VPC in which to create the web server security group. SubnetId: Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id Description: A public subnet in the default VPC (default subnets are public) for the instance. KeyPairName: Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName Description: Existing EC2 key pair used for SSH administration. AdminCidr: Type: String Description: Your network in CIDR notation (for example, 203.0.113.25/32). The only source allowed to connect over SSH. AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$' ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block, for example 203.0.113.25/32. LatestAmiId: Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 Description: Current Amazon Linux 2023 AMI resolved from the public SSM parameter for the Region. Resources: WebServerSecurityGroup: Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup Properties: GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from anywhere and SSH from the administrator CIDR only VpcId: !Ref VpcId SecurityGroupIngress: - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 443 ToPort: 443 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 Description: HTTPS from the internet - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 22 ToPort: 22 CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr Description: SSH from administrator network only Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server-sg WebServerInstance: Type: AWS::EC2::Instance Properties: InstanceType: t3.micro ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId KeyName: !Ref KeyPairName Monitoring: false MetadataOptions: HttpTokens: required HttpEndpoint: enabled NetworkInterfaces: - DeviceIndex: "0" SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId AssociatePublicIpAddress: true GroupSet: - !Ref WebServerSecurityGroup Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server UserData: !Base64 | #!/bin/bash -xe dnf install -y httpd mod_ssl openssl # Look up the public DNS name via IMDSv2 TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600") PUBLIC_DNS=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-hostname) PUBLIC_DNS=${PUBLIC_DNS:-localhost} # Generate a self-signed TLS certificate for the public DNS name openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 825 \ -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/webserver.key \ -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/webserver.crt \ -subj "/CN=${PUBLIC_DNS}" \ -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:${PUBLIC_DNS}" chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/webserver.key # Home page cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'HTML' Web Server

Welcome

This Apache web server is running on Amazon Linux 2023 over HTTPS.

HTML # Serve HTTPS only with the generated certificate cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf < ServerName ${PUBLIC_DNS} DocumentRoot "/var/www/html" SSLEngine on SSLCertificateFile /etc/pki/tls/certs/webserver.crt SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/pki/tls/private/webserver.key Require all granted EOF # Start now and on every boot systemctl enable --now httpd Outputs: PublicDnsName: Description: Public DNS name of the web server instance. Value: !GetAtt WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName WebsiteUrl: Description: HTTPS address of the home page. The certificate is self-signed, so browsers will show a warning. Value: !Sub "https://${WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName}" ```

```yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09" Description: > Single t3.micro Amazon Linux 2023 web server in the account's default VPC. Apache serves a home page over HTTPS (self-signed certificate) and starts on boot. SSH is restricted to the administrator CIDR supplied at stack creation. Parameters: KeyName: Description: Name of an existing EC2 key pair for SSH access Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName AdminCidr: Description: CIDR range of the administrator network allowed to SSH (for example 203.0.113.10/32) Type: String AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$' ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR range, for example 203.0.113.10/32 LatestAmiId: Description: Current Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI, resolved from the public SSM parameter Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 Resources: WebServerSecurityGroup: Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup Properties: # No VpcId is given, so the group is created in the account's default VPC. GroupDescription: HTTPS from anywhere, SSH only from the administrator CIDR SecurityGroupIngress: - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 443 ToPort: 443 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 Description: HTTPS from the internet - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 22 ToPort: 22 CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr Description: SSH from the administrator network only Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server-sg WebServer: Type: AWS::EC2::Instance Properties: # No SubnetId is given, so the instance launches into the default VPC's default subnet. ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId InstanceType: t3.micro KeyName: !Ref KeyName SecurityGroupIds: - !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId MetadataOptions: HttpTokens: required HttpEndpoint: enabled Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server UserData: Fn::Base64: | #!/bin/bash -xe dnf install -y httpd mod_ssl openssl # Retrieve the instance public DNS name using IMDSv2 TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300") PUBLIC_DNS=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-hostname) # Create a self-signed TLS certificate for the public DNS name openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 365 \ -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/website.key \ -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/website.crt \ -subj "/CN=$PUBLIC_DNS" chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/website.key # Point Apache's SSL configuration at the new certificate and key sed -i 's|^SSLCertificateFile .*|SSLCertificateFile /etc/pki/tls/certs/website.crt|' /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf sed -i 's|^SSLCertificateKeyFile .*|SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/pki/tls/private/website.key|' /etc/httpd/conf.d/ssl.conf # Simple home page cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF' Web Server

Hello from the web server

This page is served over HTTPS from an EC2 instance in the default VPC.

EOF # Start Apache now and on every boot systemctl enable --now httpd Outputs: PublicDNSName: Description: Public DNS name of the web server Value: !GetAtt WebServer.PublicDnsName WebsiteURL: Description: HTTPS address of the home page (self-signed certificate, so browsers will show a warning) Value: !Sub "https://${WebServer.PublicDnsName}" ```

```yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09" Description: > Single t3.micro Apache web server on Amazon Linux 2023 in the account's default VPC. Serves a home page over HTTPS (self-signed certificate) to the internet. SSH (22) is restricted to a caller-supplied CIDR. Apache is enabled to start on boot. Parameters: KeyPairName: Description: Name of an existing EC2 key pair for SSH administration. Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName AdminCidr: Description: Your network in CIDR notation (for example, 203.0.113.25/32). The only source allowed to connect over SSH. Type: String AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/([0-9]|[12][0-9]|3[0-2])$' ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block such as 203.0.113.25/32. LatestAmiId: Description: Current Amazon Linux 2023 AMI (resolved from the public SSM parameter, not hard-coded). Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64 Resources: # No VpcId is given, so this security group is created in the account's default VPC. WebServerSecurityGroup: Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup Properties: GroupDescription: HTTPS open to the internet; SSH restricted to the administrator CIDR. SecurityGroupIngress: - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 443 ToPort: 443 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 Description: HTTPS from anywhere - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 22 ToPort: 22 CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr Description: SSH from administrator network only Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server-sg WebServerInstance: Type: AWS::EC2::Instance Properties: ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId InstanceType: t3.micro KeyName: !Ref KeyPairName # No SubnetId is given, so the instance launches into the default VPC's default subnet, # which assigns a public IP address. SecurityGroupIds: - !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId MetadataOptions: HttpTokens: required HttpEndpoint: enabled Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server UserData: Fn::Base64: | #!/bin/bash set -euxo pipefail dnf install -y httpd mod_ssl # Use IMDSv2 to find this instance's public DNS name for the certificate subject. TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300") PUBLIC_HOST=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-hostname || true) [ -n "$PUBLIC_HOST" ] || PUBLIC_HOST=localhost # Self-signed certificate in the paths the mod_ssl default configuration uses. openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \ -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key \ -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/localhost.crt \ -subj "/CN=${PUBLIC_HOST}" chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF' Web Server

Hello from Apache on Amazon Linux 2023

This page is served over HTTPS.

EOF systemctl enable --now httpd Outputs: PublicDnsName: Description: Public DNS name of the web server instance. Value: !GetAtt WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName WebsiteUrl: Description: HTTPS address of the home page (self-signed certificate; browsers will show a warning). Value: !Sub "https://${WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName}" ```

```yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09" Description: >- Single t3.micro Amazon Linux 2023 web server in the default VPC running Apache with TLS (self-signed certificate) on port 443. ```yaml AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09" Description: >- Single t3.micro Amazon Linux 2023 web server in the default VPC. Apache serves a home page over HTTPS (self-signed TLS certificate generated at first boot). SSH is restricted to a single administrator CIDR. No new network infrastructure is created. GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from anywhere and SSH from the administrator CIDR only SecurityGroupIngress: - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 443 ToPort: 443 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 Description: HTTPS from the internet - IpProtocol: tcp FromPort: 22 ToPort: 22 CidrIp: !Ref AdminCidr Description: SSH from administrator network only SecurityGroupEgress: - IpProtocol: -1 CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0 Description: All outbound traffic Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server-sg WebServerInstance: Type: AWS::EC2::Instance Properties: ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType KeyName: !Ref KeyName # No SubnetId is given, so the instance launches into a default subnet of the default VPC, # which assigns a public IPv4 address automatically. SecurityGroupIds: - !GetAtt WebServerSecurityGroup.GroupId MetadataOptions: HttpTokens: required HttpEndpoint: enabled BlockDeviceMappings: - DeviceName: /dev/xvda Ebs: VolumeSize: 8 VolumeType: gp3 Encrypted: true DeleteOnTermination: true UserData: Fn::Base64: | #!/bin/bash -xe dnf install -y httpd mod_ssl # Look up this instance's public DNS name using IMDSv2 so the certificate matches it. TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 300") PUBHOST=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-hostname) # Generate a self-signed certificate in the paths the mod_ssl default configuration uses. openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 -days 825 \ -subj "/CN=$PUBHOST" \ -keyout /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key \ -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/localhost.crt chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/localhost.key # Simple home page. cat > /var/www/html/index.html <<'EOF' Web Server

Hello from Apache on Amazon Linux 2023

This site is served over HTTPS.

EOF # Start Apache now and enable it so it comes back automatically after a reboot. systemctl enable httpd systemctl restart httpd Tags: - Key: Name Value: web-server Outputs: PublicDnsName: Description: Public DNS name of the web server Value: !GetAtt WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName WebsiteAddress: Description: HTTPS address of the home page (self-signed certificate, so the browser will show a warning) Value: !Sub "https://${WebServerInstance.PublicDnsName}" ```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Photo-sharing website: custom VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with public web subnets and
  private database subnets across two Availability Zones, a web server built
  from a launch template on a custom AMI, and an encrypted RDS for MySQL instance
  reachable only from the web server.

Parameters:
  WebAmiId:
    Description: Custom AMI ID created in the labs (Apache and PHP web server image)
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id

  KeyName:
    Description: Existing EC2 key pair for SSH access to the web server
    Type: AWS::EC2::KeyPair::KeyName

  AdminCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the administrators' network allowed to use SSH (for example 203.0.113.10/32)
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(\d|[1-2]\d|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
```

```yaml
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPA.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-a'

  NatGatewayB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIPB.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-b'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTableA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-a'

  PrivateDefaultRouteA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayA

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableA

  PrivateRouteTableB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-b'

  PrivateDefaultRouteB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayB

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableB

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ALBSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Internet-facing ALB - HTTP from the internet, forwards to web servers only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web servers - HTTP from the ALB only; outbound for updates and database access
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  WebIngressFromALB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 80
      ToPort: 80
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ALBSecurityGroup

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: RDS MySQL - port 3306 from web servers only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-sg'

  DatabaseIngressFromWeb:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 3306
      ToPort: 3306
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Photo storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  PhotoBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web server IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: UploadReadDeletePhotos
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: '20'
      StorageType: gp3
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      DBName: photos
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBMasterUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load balancing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Type: application
      Scheme: internet-facing
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - !Ref PublicSubnetB
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb'

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 3
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200-399'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-tg'

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier compute
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web'
          - ResourceType: volume
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-volume'

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    Properties:
      MinSize: '2'
      MaxSize: '4'
      DesiredCapacity: '2'
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetA
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetB
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-asg'
          PropagateAtLaunch: true
    UpdatePolicy:
      AutoScalingRollingUpdate:
        MinInstancesInService: 1
        MaxBatchSize: 1
        PauseTime: PT5M

  WebCpuScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 60
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Content delivery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing site'
        HttpVersion: http2
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        Origins:
          - Id: AlbOrigin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: AlbOrigin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: Domain name of the CloudFront distribution (HTTPS entry point for viewers)
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName

  PhotoBucketName:
    Description: Name of the private S3 bucket holding uploaded photos
    Value: !Ref PhotoBucket

  DatabaseEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint address of the Multi-AZ RDS for MySQL instance (private)
    Value: !GetAtt DBInstance.Endpoint.Address

  DatabaseMasterUserSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the RDS managed master password
    Value: !GetAtt DBInstance.MasterUserSecret.SecretArn
```

```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Secure, scalable, highly available photo-sharing website. VPC with public and
  private subnets across two Availability Zones, internet-facing ALB, Auto Scaling
  group of private web servers built from a custom AMI, private S3 photo bucket,
  Multi-AZ RDS MySQL, and a CloudFront distribution that redirects HTTP to HTTPS.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Application
        Parameters:
          - CustomAmiId
          - WebInstanceType
      - Label:
          default: Database
        Parameters:
          - DBName
          - DBUsername
      - Label:
          default: Auto Scaling
        Parameters:
          - AsgMinSize
          - AsgDesiredCapacity
          - AsgMaxSize
          - CpuTargetPercent

Parameters:
  CustomAmiId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Image::Id
    Description: Custom AMI ID for the web servers (supplied at stack creation)

  WebInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.micro

  DBName:
    Type: String
    Default: photos
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,62}"
    Description: Name of the initial MySQL database

  DBUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: photoadmin
    AllowedPattern: "[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]{0,15}"
    Description: Master username for MySQL (password is generated and managed by Secrets Manager)

  AsgMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1

  AsgDesiredCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1

  AsgMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 4
    MinValue: 1

  CpuTargetPercent:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 10
    MaxValue: 90
    Description: Average CPU utilization target that triggers scale-out and scale-in

Mappings: {}

Conditions: {}

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az1"

  PublicSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az2"

  PrivateSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-az1"

  PrivateSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-az2"

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAz1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetAz2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetAz1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetAz2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Internet-facing ALB, HTTP only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP from internet
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTP to web servers in the VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg"

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web servers, reachable only from the ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTP from ALB only
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Outbound via NAT for updates and AWS APIs
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-sg"

  DatabaseSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: MySQL, reachable only from web servers
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 3306
          ToPort: 3306
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref WebSecurityGroup
          Description: MySQL from web servers only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-sg"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Photo storage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-photos"

  PhotoBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web server instance role (least privilege on the photo bucket)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PhotoBucketObjectAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: UploadReadDeletePhotos
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load balancer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
        - !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: deletion_protection.enabled
          Value: "false"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 15
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200-399"
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: "30"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web servers (Auto Scaling group in private subnets)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-lt"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref CustomAmiId
        InstanceType: !Ref WebInstanceType
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
        BlockDeviceMappings:
          - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
            Ebs:
              Encrypted: true
              VolumeType: gp3
              DeleteOnTermination: true
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    DependsOn: PrivateDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-asg"
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: !Ref AsgMinSize
      DesiredCapacity: !Ref AsgDesiredCapacity
      MaxSize: !Ref AsgMaxSize
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      EstimatedInstanceWarmup: 180
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref CpuTargetPercent
```

```yaml
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-photos"

  PhotoBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web server IAM (least privilege for photo objects only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: photo-object-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePhotoObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*"

  WebInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref WebInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Database (Multi-AZ RDS for MySQL, encrypted, password managed by RDS)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Private subnets for the photo database
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnets"

  PhotoDatabase:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Snapshot
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Snapshot
    Properties:
      Engine: mysql
      DBInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
      AllocatedStorage: "20"
      StorageType: gp2
      StorageEncrypted: true
      MultiAZ: true
      DBName: photos
      MasterUsername: !Ref DBUsername
      ManageMasterUserPassword: true
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VPCSecurityGroups:
        - !Ref DatabaseSecurityGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load balancing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApplicationLoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      IpAddressType: ipv4
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref ALBSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: "true"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alb"

  WebTargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckEnabled: true
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthCheckTimeoutSeconds: 5
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200-399"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-tg"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: 80
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref WebTargetGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Web tier (Auto Scaling in private subnets, no public IPs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-${AWS::Region}"
      LaunchTemplateData:
        ImageId: !Ref AmiId
        InstanceType: t3.micro
        IamInstanceProfile:
          Arn: !GetAtt WebInstanceProfile.Arn
        NetworkInterfaces:
          - DeviceIndex: 0
            AssociatePublicIpAddress: false
            Groups:
              - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpEndpoint: enabled
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
        Monitoring:
          Enabled: true
        UserData:
          Fn::Base64: !Sub |
            #!/bin/bash
            cat > /etc/photo-app.env <<EOF
            AWS_REGION=${AWS::Region}
            PHOTO_BUCKET=${PhotoBucket}
            DB_HOST=${PhotoDatabase.Endpoint.Address}
            DB_PORT=${PhotoDatabase.Endpoint.Port}
            DB_NAME=photos
            EOF
            chmod 644 /etc/photo-app.env

  WebAutoScalingGroup:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup
    UpdatePolicy:
      AutoScalingRollingUpdate:
        MinInstancesInService: 1
        MaxBatchSize: 1
        PauseTime: PT5M
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web-asg"
      VPCZoneIdentifier:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LaunchTemplate:
        LaunchTemplateId: !Ref WebLaunchTemplate
        Version: !GetAtt WebLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber
      MinSize: "2"
      DesiredCapacity: "2"
      MaxSize: "4"
      TargetGroupARNs:
        - !Ref WebTargetGroup
      HealthCheckType: ELB
      HealthCheckGracePeriod: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-web"
          PropagateAtLaunch: true

  WebCpuScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::AutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      AutoScalingGroupName: !Ref WebAutoScalingGroup
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      TargetTrackingConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: ASGAverageCPUUtilization
        TargetValue: 60
        DisableScaleIn: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Content delivery (CloudFront -> ALB, HTTP redirected to HTTPS)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudFrontDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub "${AWS::StackName} photo-sharing site"
        HttpVersion: http2
        IPV6Enabled: true
        PriceClass: PriceClass_100
        Origins:
          - Id: alb-origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
            CustomOriginConfig:
              HTTPPort: 80
              HTTPSPort: 443
              OriginProtocolPolicy: http-only
              OriginSSLProtocols:
                - TLSv1.2
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: alb-origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: redirect-to-https
          AllowedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
            - OPTIONS
            - PUT
            - POST
            - PATCH
            - DELETE
          CachedMethods:
            - GET
            - HEAD
          Compress: true
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a6d8a0d0a
          OriginRequestPolicyId: 216adef6-5c7f-47e4-b989-5492eafa07d3
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

Outputs:
  CloudFrontDomainName:
    Description: CloudFront domain name for the photo-sharing site (HTTPS)
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFrontDistribution.DomainName

  LoadBalancerDNSName:
    Description: DNS name of the internet-facing Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
```
